This is 1 single video of our complete 4 day Ayodhya Dham journey, where we explored the spiritual, cultural, historical, and food side of Ayodhya across multiple days.
old ayodhya dham video
In this series, we visited famous temples, ghats, hidden spiritual places, local food spots, and also interacted with saints, scholars, and locals to understand the deeper connection of Ayodhya with Shri Ram.
